text: BAM share rose 0.06 percentage points over 21 hours and 0.54 percentage points over 7 days, putting BAM at 34.6% of all Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 21.8% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 71 top-node leadership changes in the window fit whale-driven routing, not structural rollover.
